description:
The Army and Air Force Exchange Service (Exchange) will be soliciting for

Systems Furniture Development, Demolition, Reuse & Installation project at the Army & Air Force Exchange Service (The Exchange) Headquarters, Dallas, TX in the near future.  

The Statement of Work (SOW) and Drawings are attached.

If you are interested in receiving this solicitation and if the SOW is a project that your company can accomplish, please complete the requested information below (2nd page) and return it to Christian Villamin at villaminc@aafes.com by COB Wednesday, 4 March 2026.  If you would like to propose on our other solicitations, please visit our website at https://odin.aafes.com/ConstructionSolicitations/
